===Turael boosting===
{{Main|Slayer reward points}}
A popular strategy to gain [[Slayer reward point]]s faster is called Turael boosting. Tasks that will award bonus points are taken from higher level masters who award more points. The tasks in between are taken from [[Turael]] instead, making them easier and quicker to complete. However, taking these lower level tasks will result in slower experience.
